    Our Story

    From a restaurant
    to a truck Tuscaloosa loves

    Se7ens started as a physical restaurant founded by Tim Anderson and his cousin Markeldon Washington — and now brings that same kitchen on the road as a mobile food truck.

    In August 2026 the truck showed off a fresh new wrap and opened bookings for the fall — ready for game days, campus events, workplaces and private parties across Tuscaloosa.

    Mobile in TuscaloosaBase listed at 1735 Culver Rd, Tuscaloosa, AL 35473 — the truck comes to you.
    UA Approved CateringListed on the University of Alabama approved catering program list (updated Oct 8, 2026).
    Now booking for fallAccepting bookings — as shared in the truck's August 2026 update.
